caption: The three matrices in the order they touch the point: shift to (2, 0), turn to (0, 2), shift back to (1, 3). Written as the product T(1,1) · R(90°) · T(−1,−1) they collapse into one matrix M, so a single multiply lands on the same point (1, 3).

spec.title: Rotating (3, 1) by 90° about the fixed point (1, 1)
spec.aria: A chain from the vertex (3, 1) through the matrices T(−1,−1), R(90°) and T(1,1), giving (2, 0), then (0, 2), then (1, 3), with the combined matrix M reaching the same point in one multiply.
